localizedDescriptions.en: Create WeCom documents, manage tables, arrange meetings and follow up on work.
localizedDescriptions.zh-CN: 编写企业微信文档、管理表格、安排会议并跟进工作。

en: Organize a weekly project update from the WeCom documents and tasks I can access.
Prepare a meeting agenda using the relevant WeCom documents and calendar.
zh-CN: 根据我有权访问的企业微信文档和任务整理项目周报。
结合相关企业微信文档和日历准备会议议程。

instructions.en: Scan the official WeCom QR code to authorize the bot. Available resources and actions depend on enterprise settings and your granted permissions.
instructions.zh-CN: 扫描企业微信官方二维码授权机器人；可用资源和操作受企业设置及已授予权限限制。
